metaTitle: Custom Small Gift Boxes & Ribbons | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom small gift boxes and ribbons for your next event or promotion. Perfect for gifts, favors, and retail packaging from Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Small gift boxes and ribbons are ideal for presenting jewelry, gift cards, or small promotional items. Whether you need corrugated mailers or elegant satin ribbon, these compact sizes keep your branding close to the product. Dye-sublimated ribbon allows full-color logos on narrow widths, while colored tissue paper adds a premium unboxing experience. Perfect for corporate gifts, event favors, or retail packaging.
heroAltText: Custom small gift boxes and ribbons with branded tissue paper and dye-sublimated ribbon for corporate gifts
